note: Two entities were bundled in one input row and are assessed separately. (1) DOLFIN RUBBERS LIMITED — real, dated export shipments confirmed: B/L 1077135 dated 2026-02-27, LCS Nepalgunj Road INNGRB -> Nepalganj, NEPAL, HS 40114010 and 40114090 (tyres). Note the declared HS 401390 does not match the actual shipped codes 40114010/40114090 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 40114010/40114090 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Also note the address on the customs record is 'SIHARA MARKEET, ST.NO 2, DASHMESH NAGAR LINK ROAD' (Ludhiana, Punjab), consistent with the Ludhiana ICD port lane. (2) R S STEEL TRADERS — no shipment traces found: ImportKey pages for both slug variants /r-s-steel-traders and /rs-steel-traders returned an empty record shell ('Loading...', no shipment rows, no suppliers, no buyers, no ports, no dates). No export or domestic supply evidence located; export_status and domestic_status for this entity are none_found. It is a trader-type name, which per rule 1 is not a rejection ground, but no factual shipments could be verified. Revenue and export volume for both entities: null — not public in the sources reachable within the tool budget; no figures were estimated.
